summary: Official warnings for Ondansetron include severe allergic reactions that can affect breathing, as well as heart rhythm issues known as QT interval prolongation and Torsade de Pointes [3]. If serious allergic reactions are suspected, the drug should be stopped and treated right away [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated medium-risk scores of 60 for the liver and 56 for the heart [M].
